scope: Current native Core sources; Workflow and Workbench source files excluded. Operator catalog and Relation descriptors belong to other lanes. Findings are bounded, not a proof that unsearched language constructs are absent.

previews.change: Align Subject qualification examples with Current R2471/R2615.
Align qualified-selector examples and bound syntax with R2471/R2243; remove obsolete blanket exclusion and draft staging text. Claim otherwise preserved.

inventory.evidence: R2471/R2615 := for qualified Subjects and filtered Node expressions; : outside selections is allowed value. R1931 and R1194 show obsolete colon forms. Subject metadata is an address, not a complete expression.
R2471 gives (Node, Node.**) and (Node//, (Node//).**); commas combine selectors, repeated instance matches count once.

R2597/R2471 semicolon separates complete expressions, line break is layout; R2601 groups one expression. R2707 demonstrates boolean AND and IF/THEN grouped syntax; full formal grammar, IF binding, nested grouped-body expression separators and end-of-block optional terminator not located in this bounded audit.

R2604 binds existing instance; R2471 repeated references select same member. R2555 uses declaration binding and arithmetic; name scope, binding lifetime, missing operands and arithmetic precedence are not explicitly established by those sources.

R2243 shows [value format], per-property counts and immediate/recursive name filters. Exact lexical syntax for strings, escapes, enum literals, numeric intervals and typed range combinations not established by these sources.
R2243 distinguishes {:n} bound, {=n}/{>n} conditions and {==n} conclusion, and per-endpoint Relation-instance counts. R1931 still shows bare {n} conflicting with R2243.

R2602/R2612 immediate/recursive properties; R2243 recursive counts distinct descendant property identities per bearer. R2608 tests membership; R2614 exclusion is scoped to delivery selections. General grammar for in-list selector and exclusion nesting is not specified in those declarations.

R2609 reverse <((RELATION)) same fact with swapped endpoints/counts, no inverse permission; R2596 >> delivery. Endpoint typing authority R2613; unary/binary semantics and permissions are relation-lane cross-reference.

questions: What lexical quoting and escaping rules distinguish literal strings, multiword names and reserved tokens in CFEL, and are numeric intervals inside a format list inclusive?
What is binding scope/lifetime across semicolon-separated expressions and IF branches, and what happens for an unbound or absent selected instance?
For nested boolean, arithmetic and relation expressions, what precedence and associativity apply; should unparenthesized mixes be rejected?
Is a final semicolon required, and may a THEN parenthesized body contain multiple semicolon-separated expressions?
Does in (list) select Nodes, literal values, or both depending on context, and what are allowed nested exclusion operands?
not_resolved: The example R2555 uses = in a THEN result; Current R2594 says = tests and R2593/R2471 == concludes or sets. Flag for owner review; do not silently change an actual formula.
One-active-subject syntax and R1931 passive subjects require separate source review; no unsupported replacement was invented.
Operator catalog and relation descriptor repairs are excluded; user decision ?== must be coordinated with their owner.
